title: Cordova esbuild Serve Target
description: Serves a Cordova application with live reload using the esbuild dev server.

cordovaBuildTarget.description: The Cordova build target (using this package's cordova-build builder).

consolelogs.description: Print app console logs to the terminal (requires consolelogs-port).
